tonight.headline: The tight-end seat changed hands again; the lineup is now the projection lineup
body: Bad news first. You dropped Kenyon Sadiq for Darren Waller at 09:44 this morning, the fourth change on that seat in about ten days. Sadiq was never downgraded: he's still questionable, and he now sits on waivers until Wednesday. Waller's 8 targets last week came after Jalen Coker left hurt, and Coker is questionable again, so Waller's week depends on another man's quad. The Ravens D/ST are without Trey Hendrickson. ESPN has you at 123.4 against Team 13's 88.3, 68%, because they still start two players who are ruled out.

Nothing left to do. Josh Downs is in the flex, where the projection wanted him, and Keenan Allen was ruled out this afternoon, which adds to his share. The lineup as set is the projection lineup and no starter carries a designation. Jonathan Taylor and Downs lock at 07:30 tomorrow in London.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 still start DeVonta Smith and Rachaad White, both ruled out, at 0.0 each, with Kyle Pitts (7.4) at tight end and Travis Kelce (11.8) in the flex. On their bench: Lamar Jackson 20.3, DJ Moore 13.0, Dalton Kincaid 10.7 and Blake Corum 8.1. Josh Allen has no designation.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Team 13 moving Moore and Corum in for Smith and White: about 21 projected points back, which takes 88.3 to roughly 109 and the gap to about 14.

whatWentWrong.title: Four tight ends in ten days, and this one's role belongs to Coker's quad
whatWentWrong.lead: Hockenson, Gadsden, Sadiq, now Waller. Sadiq was dropped a day before his first game for you, still only questionable.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Sadiq: limited Wednesday to Friday, questionable, no downgrade today; one Yahoo writer guesses 'spot duty', which is opinion (Yahoo, 3 Oct). Waller: 2, 3, 8 targets (archive); the 8 came once Coker left in Week 3, when he ran a route on 65.6% of dropbacks and was targeted on 38% of them (Sharp Football, 1 Oct). Coker is questionable and Carolina elevated a receiver today.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: The move itself is defensible: Waller is healthy, plays the defence allowing the most points to tight ends, and cost no priority. The pattern isn't. Every one of the last three tight-end adds has closed WRONG or CHURN in the log, and Sadiq can't come back without a claim.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker active on Sunday night and Waller back under five targets: then the seat is open again on Tuesday, and Andrews (free, 10.1) is the comparison. Leave it alone until then.

worthALook.name: Mark Andrews
worthALook.lead: The tight-end comparison: free, healthy and 0.8 above Waller. A coin flip on a seat you changed this morning. Hold.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Andrews 10.1 at home to Tennessee, Waller 9.3 against Detroit. Andrews runs a route on 65.6% of dropbacks with 23.7% of Baltimore's targets, and is TE20 in points per game (FantasyPros Primer, 3 Oct); 6, 7, 5 targets (archive). He has no game status. Zay Flowers is questionable with a hamstring listing the Ravens call rest.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.8 is inside the two-point coin-flip line, and the seat changed hands at 09:44 today. Waller faces the defence allowing the most points to tight ends, 68 in three games (footballdb); Andrews has scored 8.9, 10.9 and 5.4 (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker confirmed active before Baltimore's 11:00 kickoff, which he won't be: Carolina's inactives come at 16:50. So in practice, nothing before Tuesday.

worthALook.name: Bears D/ST
worthALook.lead: The D/ST comparison: the Bills went to Furia Regia this morning. The best free defence is now the Bears, 0.5 above the Ravens. Hold.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Bears 7.5 at home to the Jets, Ravens 7.0 at home to Tennessee. Chicago have 6 takeaways in three games and held their last two opponents to 9 and 7 points (ChicagoBears.com, 3 Oct). The Jets are without Hall, Mitchell, Taylor and their left guard, but have turned it over once all season.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Half a point, on a seat that changed hands on Wednesday. Chicago start a backup quarterback and lost their left tackle to IR today, which is short fields for the Jets. The Steelers, 8.2 on paper, played Thursday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Ravens' number falling two points below a free defence that hasn't kicked off.

Neither is on his team's final report (Seahawks.com; SI, 2 Oct). The Chargers sit in a three-way tie for the 10th-most kicker points allowed (footballdb, three weeks).

doNotChase.name: George Holani
doNotChase.lead: The wire's biggest riser by a distance: Seattle's rookie starter is out, and Holani is the smaller half of what's left.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Jadarian Price re-aggravated a chest injury on Wednesday and is ruled out, with no timeline: Macdonald is unsure how long he'll miss (Seattle Sports, 2 Oct). Seahawks.com says Holani and Emanuel Wilson 'will carry the load' against the Chargers. Holani caught 5 of 5 targets for 48 yards in Week 3 (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8, 4, 3 carries against Wilson's 2, 21, 9 (archive); SI projects the split at about 60% Wilson, 35% Holani — an analyst's guess, not the team's. Wilson is rostered here by Los Cachanillas. Zach Charbonnet is practising and can come off PUP in Week 5 (Seahawks.com 2 Oct), and KEI returns hold him. Holani projects 10.3, under Kamara (10.6), already on your bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Holani out-carrying Wilson tomorrow with Price still out next week and Charbonnet not activated.
